text.en: 1. These Rules are the Parking Places (Electronic Service System) Rules 2019 and come into operation on 3 June 2019.
2. In these Rules, “electronic service system” means the system providing for electronic service established under section 43 of the Land Transport Authority of Singapore Act (Cap. 158A).

heading.en: Authorisation to serve notices, etc., through electronic service system

text.en:
3.—(1) For the purposes of section 18(1A)(d) of the Act, a notice, order or document in relation to a matter specified in the First Schedule is authorised to be served through the electronic service system on the Superintendent.
(2) For the purposes of section 18(1A)(d) of the Act, a notice, order or document in relation to a matter specified in the Second Schedule is authorised to be served through the electronic service system on a recipient.
